mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a single month indicates a weakening labor market, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and lower corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.1 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent increase in housing starts over three consecutive months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods following the signal, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 1% in a single month indicates a contraction in supply, which can lead to reduced economic output and lower corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals strong consumer demand, which can lead to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it indicates inflationary pressure under tight monetary policy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary pressure under tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a single month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a strong labor market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.1 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the periods following the signal, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
